title: Agent-OS Convergence: Hermes+Obsidian+Claude Trinity, Mapped
headline: Three builders assembled the same agent-OS this week, by hand.
description:
Three independent builders — Prajwal Tomar, CyrilXBT, Divyansh Tiwari — converged on the same architecture this week: persistent memory, a scheduler, and an executor, wired into one loop. None cited each other. None cited the system that already runs this natively.

operator: give this to your agent. This report traces each builder's setup line by line — Obsidian vault, Hermes scheduler, Claude Code executor — against a working reference implementation of the same trinity: git-versioned memory, a sensor-driven task queue, and a lock-gated dispatch loop. You get the comparison table, the gaps each builder hasn't closed yet (no priority queue, no on-chain identity, unversioned memory), and the two things the reference system could still borrow from them.
